name: doc.cheap (Remote)
description: Official doc.cheap remote MCP server: reads passports, national ID cards and driver's licences from a photo or scan and returns the printed fields, including the MRZ, as structured JSON. Tools scan a document, check the balance, search the API docs, and list, read or delete stored results. Works without a key on the public sandbox; add a doc.cheap API key for your own documents.

inputs.label: doc.cheap API Key
inputs.description: Optional. Without a key the server uses the public sandbox key; a live key reads your own documents and comes with 100 free recognitions every month. Starts with sk_live_.

obtain.instructions:
1. Go to doc.cheap/register
2. Create an account
3. Open API keys in the account menu
4. Copy your key (starts with sk_live_)

auth.instructions: Optional. Works without a key on the public sandbox key. For your own documents, create a key at doc.cheap; it is sent in the X-Doc-Cheap-Api-Key header.
